en: The postcard shows a black-and-white photograph of a park-like area with several trees and some buildings in the background, one of which has a pointed spire resembling a church. The lower part of the image contains handwritten Swedish text. On the reverse side, there is a Swedish postage stamp marked 1903, standardized printed lines for address information, and both handwritten and printed Swedish text.
